_note: Ordered by information, not convenience. Every arm runs on suite 0.4.0.
_design_2026-09-19: A matched pair of Nemotron sweeps, varying ONE thing: whether the model reasons. Sweep `nothink` sends think=false and floors num_predict at 400; sweep `think` sends think=true and floors it at 4096. Same model, same arms, same suite, same rep count. The pair exists because the 2026-09-18 sweep ran with Nemotron's audit and judge stages returning empty text on every call -- reasoning consumed the 200-token cap before any answer appeared (50-findings/12, addenda 1 and 2), so that sweep measured the implementation stage alone and neither half of this pair reproduces it.
_floors: 400 for nothink: with reasoning off the audit answer alone costs a median 212 tokens and 5 of 8 runs truncate at 200; 300, 400 and 600 all parse 8/8. 4096 for think: ten reps of one prompt span 609-2635 eval tokens, and 2048 completed only 8 of 10.
_monolith_is_the_subtrahend_not_a_contro: monolith makes one model call, to the implementer, with no audit and no judge stage. Turning reasoning off changes that call like any other -- a reasoning model writing code without reasoning writes different code -- so the two sweeps are NOT expected to agree there. It is the cleanest measurement of what reasoning does to the implementer alone, and the judge arms measure the whole pipeline; the difference between the two is what isolates reasoning's effect on judging. If reasoning moves monolith by n and a judge arm by n as well, it did nothing for judging.
_consistency_check: The 2026-09-18 dark sweep sent no `think` key, so the model reasoned by default, and its implementer had 1536 tokens -- enough to exit the thinking block, which is why work landed there at all. Its monolith earned 13 of 28. The `think` sweep's monolith should land close to that. A large divergence means something other than reasoning moved between the runs.
_grouping: Each sweep runs its 16 arms together so Ollama swaps models once. The qwen top-ups run last and are unaffected by any of this.
